sections.title: Critical Writing Seminar: Sophomore Transfer Writing Seminar
sections.description: Open only to sophomore transfer students who have not fulfilled their writing requirement. These seminars follow the same curriculum as the first-year seminars but are aimed at those who are transferring to Penn after completing one year of study at a previous institution. The text used in this class will be interdisciplinary and allow for broad research applications, helping sophomore transfers to find a topic of personal interest for their writing projects as they settle into a new academic environment among their peers.
